_about: SOUL size S: single source of truth for the final product size (decision 2026-10-20). Details, method and sources: docs/12-SIZE-S.md. [V] = verified on Waveshare's page/wiki/drawing/STEP on 2026-10-20; [E] = estimate.
shape: MARGARITAR v9 at its native design scale (renders/v9/src/marg_geo.py local geometry), back half compressed by s_back
dims_note: w 62.96 and h 70.8 (foot bottom to crown, incl. the 1.2 mm polymer foot) are the marg_geo local numbers [V, computed]; d 23.0 is the chosen target (s_back 0.807; the M renders use 0.735 = 22.05 mm at this scale, the uncompressed shape is 25.65 mm)
glass: custom flat 2.5D black-printed cover glass, 0.7 mm, 45 deg chamfer seat [E]
display: 1.75" round AMOLED, CO5300 driver, QSPI, capacitive touch (CST9217 on the Waveshare board), active area 43.76 mm, true black

board.product: custom round PCB ~46 mm, ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8 + bare 1.75" AMOLED panel, AXP2101-class PMU, ES8311 + ES7210-class codecs, 2 MEMS mics [E, EVT]

battery: LiPo 603040 class (6.2 x 30.5 x 42 mm incl. PCM, 750 mAh typ / 720 min, 2.8 Wh) [V-s datasheet listing]; custom pouch of the same envelope at DVT
weight_note: [E] 75-95 g: alu shell ~46 g, cell ~15 g, PCB ~7 g, glass + panel ~6 g, polymer chassis + foot ~6 g, rest ~5 g

est_battery_life.model: docs/09 section 3 day (1 h awake, 15 h asleep or screen off, 8 h deep sleep, 50 questions) with the S currents in docs/12 section 2.5: ~661 mAh/day [E]

S-P0_dev_board.board: Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.75 with its stock glass (TP OD 48.96 mm)
S-P0_dev_board.battery: LiPo 503030 class (5.0 x 30 x 30 mm, ~450 mAh [E], PCM, 2-pin MX1.25 lead); CAD envelope 30.5 x 31 x 5.55 incl. PCM tape + 0.5 swell
S-P0_dev_board.battery_note: the exported S-P0 CAD (prototip/cad/soul_p0_s.py, batfit search 2026-10-20) fits a 503030, not the 503035 (500 mAh) first planned in docs/12 section 2.3: with the USB-C plug tunnel under the board a 35 mm cell does not fit the narrower MARGARITAR bottom. Capacity is the listing class [E] until a cell is in hand.
S-P0_dev_board.est_battery_life_note: [E] 18 h at 500 mAh scaled by capacity (docs/12 section 2.5, dev board deep sleep ~2 mA)

M_prototype.dims_note: 90 x 101 x 31.5 is the M design (renders v9); the DIY P0-M kit around the stock 2.8C board (glass 95.86 mm) is 112.1 x 125.1 x 31.6 (prototip/README.md)
M_prototype.role: prototype for tests and the PoC TRL 3 proof (SoulOS 1.9.1, firmware/release/SOUL-2.8C-install.bin)

cnc.external_shell_factor_note: [E] one factor for bought-in CNC, bead-blast and anodise per set, S vs M (docs/12 section 3.1): surface x 0.50, billet 0.4 / 1.0 kg = x 0.40, cycle 24 / 45 min = x 0.53, plus fixed set-up, handling and lot shares that do not scale. Used by docs/01-BOM SV-07, the factory model (docs/factory) and the campaign goal model (crowdfunding/facts.json size_S.cost_factors_vs_M)
